routing_reason: Recorded supervisor block: Made real progress but did not reach FUNCTION_MATCH within 3 attempts. Baseline candidate (956 B) had a genuine bug: local DATAFILE *assets in the m->flags&16 block was CANDIDATE_ONLY_DEBUG_DECLARATION (frame_layout.local_inventory) -- no historical DWARF counterpart existed for it, and its presence caused STACK_FRAME_LAYOUT DIFFER (candidate sub esp,0x15c vs historical sub esp,0x16c, first mismatch at offset 8). Attempt 1: removed the unevidenced local and inlined (DATAFILE*)mp->data+mp->fo directly into the three draw_sprite calls -- this made the prologue's stack allocation match exactly (sub /usr/bin/bashx16c,%esp on both sides) and advanced the difference_class from STACK_FRAME_LAYOUT to REGISTER_OR_INSTRUCTION_SELECTION, first difference moving from offset 8 to offset 16: historically mp (0x10(%ebp)) is kept in callee-saved %edi for the whole function (alongside bmp=%esi, m=%ebx), but the candidate demotes mp to %edx and only loads m into %ebx, reloading mp from the stack later. Attempt 2: rephrased the inlined expression as ((DATAFILE*)mp->data)[mp->fo+N] instead of ((DATAFILE*)mp->data+mp->fo)[N] -- byte-identical output, no effect. Attempt 3: swapped the h=mp->font_height-12 / stepIn=dx statement order -- byte-identical output, no effect. The remaining mismatch is a global register-allocation choice (which of bmp/m/mp gets a callee-saved register) that this session found no further DWARF-evidenced or source-legal lever to influence; routing to supervisor. Candidate remains 896 B against the 1118 B historical body.
